title: Team &
lede: Lanes are where someone leads by default. Anyone can join a mob in any lane.

people.name: Mawuli
people.owns: The vision, priorities and roadmap sign-off. Re-articulates goals and needs so the team always knows the end product; trusts the builders on the how. Final say at review calls.

people.name: Vishav
people.owns: Backend and data, contributor intake (15–20 min calls), the contributor sheet, sprint planning with Jonathan, merges to main.

people.name: Jonathan
people.owns: Frontend, globe interaction and motion (the hex load is his), code review, sprint planning with Vishav.

people.name: Andrea
people.owns: Full-stack + UI/UX (London). Tester program, bug triage flow, usability. The prioritization method in this SOP is hers.

people.name: Laura
people.owns: UI and visual feel: turning the convention-hall feeling into the interface.

people.name: New devs
people.owns: Join through the builder application, then get an open problem sized to their weekly hours.

items.text: What we build and why, sprint themes, what ships at the review call.

items.text: How it's built: architecture, who's in which mob, code review standards, merge order.
